quote: At Home, the crunch subject is the Colony. Citizens contribute in equal, individually apportioned shares; good stewardship creates a stable home that can run well, make room for ambition, and permit ordinary life to be experienced.
claim: At Home, the crunch subject is the Colony, with Citizens contributing in equal, individually apportioned shares so good stewardship creates a stable home that supports ambition and ordinary life.

quote: Document version | 1.0
claim: This specification is Document version 1.0.

quote: Game-system target | Home Loop Rework 0.4.7
claim: The specification targets Home Loop Rework 0.4.7.

quote: Status | Canon working specification
claim: The document's status is Canon working specification.

quote: RTS production grid | Colony posture | Buildings no longer operate primarily as stand-alone factories. Places support Practices; Citizens occupy Roles; the colony succeeds as a whole.
claim: Buildings no longer operate as stand-alone factories; instead Places support Practices, Citizens occupy Roles, and the colony succeeds as a whole.

quote: Worker optimization | Equal civic shares | Each assigned Citizen contributes one unit of Role Capacity at Home. Personal aptitudes belong to Away Mode, not domestic productivity ranking.
claim: Each assigned Citizen contributes one unit of Role Capacity at Home, replacing worker optimization, while personal aptitudes belong to Away Mode rather than domestic productivity ranking.

quote: Continuous entropy | Achievable equilibrium | Adequate coverage can fully absorb routine load. The colony is allowed to become genuinely stable rather than merely decay more slowly.
claim: Adequate coverage can fully absorb routine load, replacing continuous entropy with an achievable, genuinely stable equilibrium rather than merely slower decay.

quote: Local repair clicking | Global condition | Diffuse wear, flood strain, loosened lashings, and ordinary upkeep are compressed into colony-scale Conditions.
claim: Diffuse wear, flood strain, loosened lashings, and ordinary upkeep are compressed into colony-scale Conditions instead of local repair clicking.

quote: Passive debuffs | Latent vulnerability | Role shortfalls create deficiencies and exposure. They do not automatically inflict daily punishment in every affected category.
claim: Role shortfalls create deficiencies and exposure as latent vulnerability rather than automatically inflicting daily punishment in every affected category.

quote: Generic random events | Weakness-shaped MEET | A hidden Role ledger controls shortfall-Encounter pressure. The two most relevant weak points determine how a Colony Encounter manifests.
claim: A hidden Role ledger controls shortfall-Encounter pressure, with the two most relevant weak points determining how a Colony Encounter manifests, replacing generic random events.

quote: Five-button event board | Three-choice transaction | A Home Encounter normally offers two different spends protecting different stakes, or a refusal that suffers the compound result.
claim: A Home Encounter normally offers two different spends protecting different stakes, or a refusal that suffers the compound result, replacing a five-button event board.

quote: Flavor text as reward | Quiet Equilibrium and EMBODY | Competent Dwell produces mental and calendar space. EMBODY becomes globally available at Home for any present, available Citizen.
claim: Competent Dwell produces mental and calendar space, and EMBODY becomes globally available at Home for any present, available Citizen, replacing flavor text as reward.

quote: The Home Loop is the operating architecture of the Colony Register (DWELL). It replaces the familiar base-builder model of isolated production buildings, service radii, worker throughput, and continuous attrition
claim: The Home Loop is the operating architecture of the Colony Register (DWELL), replacing isolated production buildings, service radii, worker throughput, and continuous attrition with a colony-scale stewardship system.

quote: The player's task is not to prevent perpetual collapse. It is to establish and periodically restore the conditions under which ordinary life can occur.
claim: The player's task is to establish and periodically restore the conditions under which ordinary life can occur, not to prevent perpetual collapse.

quote: Create a mechanically credible domestic life whose success can be understood and achieved.
claim: The system aims to create a mechanically credible domestic life whose success can be understood and achieved.

quote: Make low population meaningful: every assigned headcount is a visible civic commitment and an Away opportunity cost.
claim: Low population is made meaningful by having every assigned headcount serve as a visible civic commitment and an Away opportunity cost.

quote: Express species identity through settlement topology rather than through decorative building skins or generic bonuses.
claim: Species identity is expressed through settlement topology rather than decorative building skins or generic bonuses.

quote: Allow routine competence to suppress crises without requiring constant player attention.
claim: Routine competence should suppress crises without requiring constant player attention.

quote: Convert abstract shortfalls into specific, memorable situations through the Encounter Register (MEET).
claim: Abstract shortfalls are converted into specific, memorable situations through the Encounter Register (MEET).

quote: Provide Quiet Equilibrium as the enabling condition for EMBODY, Campaign Memory, voluntary Projects, and emotional linger time.
claim: Quiet Equilibrium is the enabling condition for EMBODY, Campaign Memory, voluntary Projects, and emotional linger time.

quote: Citizens hold Roles. Roles sustain Practices. Practices inhabit Places. Places create Load according to species spatial logic. Capacity meeting Load produces Readiness; unresolved deficiency becomes vulnerability; MEET turns vulnerability into a situated choice.
claim: Citizens hold Roles, Roles sustain Practices, Practices inhabit Places, Places create Load by species spatial logic, Capacity meeting Load produces Readiness, unresolved deficiency becomes vulnerability, and MEET turns vulnerability into a situated choice.

quote: MEDIAN uses different scales of mechanical attention in Home and Away play. This is not a difference between anonymous and named Citizens. It is a difference in the subject being resolved.
claim: MEDIAN uses different scales of mechanical attention in Home and Away play, differing in the subject being resolved rather than in whether Citizens are named.

quote: Crunch subject | The Colony | The individual Citizen or expedition party
claim: The crunch subject is the Colony in Home Mode and the individual Citizen or expedition party in Away Modes.

quote: Primary question | How much civic capacity is committed to each responsibility? | Which particular Citizen can survive, solve, carry, notice, or endure this situation?
claim: The primary Home question is how much civic capacity is committed to each responsibility, while the primary Away question is which particular Citizen can survive, solve, carry, notice, or endure the situation.

quote: Citizen unit | One equal, individually apportioned Role share | Personal abilities, gear, conditions, history, and exposure
claim: The Citizen unit at Home is one equal, individually apportioned Role share, while Away it is personal abilities, gear, conditions, history, and exposure.

quote: Growth target | Places, Practices, reserves, margins, population, and colony tier | Citizen capability, equipment, wounds, distinctions, relationships, and experience
claim: The Home growth target is Places, Practices, reserves, margins, population, and colony tier, while the Away growth target is Citizen capability, equipment, wounds, distinctions, relationships, and experience.

quote: Primary risk | A weakened colony posture caused by absence, expansion, season, or shortfall | Hazard, injury, Exposure, Tharn, loss, or individual reward
claim: The primary Home risk is a weakened colony posture caused by absence, expansion, season, or shortfall, while the primary Away risk is hazard, injury, Exposure, Tharn, loss, or individual reward.

quote: Success affect | Stability, confidence, and room to inhabit | Return, survival, discovery, and transformed Citizens
claim: Home success affect is stability, confidence, and room to inhabit, while Away success affect is return, survival, discovery, and transformed Citizens.

quote: At Home, a Citizen is an individually accounted-for unit of commitment. Away, a Citizen is an individually resolved unit of capability.
claim: At Home, a Citizen is an individually accounted-for unit of commitment; Away, a Citizen is an individually resolved unit of capability.

quote: Colony | DWELL | Home | Maintains Roles, Places, Projects, Conditions, and Readiness.
claim: The Colony register, verb DWELL, is primarily available at Home and maintains Roles, Places, Projects, Conditions, and Readiness.

quote: Field | TRAVEL | Away | Carries Citizens through distance and environmental drag.
claim: The Field register, verb TRAVEL, is primarily available Away and carries Citizens through distance and environmental drag.

quote: Crossing | RISK | Away | Resolves immediate spatial panic and traffic-scale hazard.
claim: The Crossing register, verb RISK, is primarily available Away and resolves immediate spatial panic and traffic-scale hazard.

quote: Encounter | MEET | Home and Away | Stages any bounded consequential situation: storm, collapse, stranger, predator, discovery, or dispute.
claim: The Encounter register, verb MEET, is available Home and Away and stages any bounded consequential situation such as storm, collapse, stranger, predator, discovery, or dispute.

quote: Embodiment | EMBODY | Home only | Makes successful sanctuary perceptible through guided Citizen-scale experience.
claim: The Embodiment register, verb EMBODY, is available Home only and makes successful sanctuary perceptible through guided Citizen-scale experience.

quote: DWELL establishes order -\> Citizens leave -\> AWAY creates exposure -\> Citizens return -\> DWELL restores equilibrium -\> EMBODY makes safety felt
claim: The Home Loop cycle runs: DWELL establishes order, Citizens leave, AWAY creates exposure, Citizens return, DWELL restores equilibrium, and EMBODY makes safety felt.

quote: The colony is the Home crunch subject.** Domestic calculations operate globally. Individual names remain attached to assignments, absence, advice, memory, and availability without becoming productivity multipliers.
claim: The colony is the Home crunch subject; domestic calculations operate globally while individual names remain attached to assignments, absence, advice, memory, and availability without becoming productivity multipliers.

quote: A stable colony can actually be stable.** Adequate Capacity fully covers routine Load. The system does not manufacture daily chores merely to preserve engagement.
claim: Adequate Capacity fully covers routine Load, so the system does not manufacture daily chores merely to preserve engagement.

quote: The reward for sound stewardship is a broad plateau of safety in which Projects, observation, EMBODY, and ordinary Citizen life can occur.
claim: Sound stewardship rewards the player with a broad plateau of safety enabling Projects, observation, EMBODY, and ordinary Citizen life.

quote: Diffuse structural wear, care work, storage attention, and watchfulness are colony postures. They need not be simulated as hundreds of tiny local tasks.
claim: Diffuse structural wear, care work, storage attention, and watchfulness are colony postures that need not be simulated as hundreds of tiny local tasks.

quote: When an abstract vulnerability matters enough to become a story, MEET places it in a specific zone, Place, household, route, or relationship.
claim: When an abstract vulnerability matters enough to become a story, MEET places it in a specific zone, Place, household, route, or relationship.

quote: Insufficient coverage raises the likelihood and stakes of a fitting Colony Encounter instead of applying a constant stack of unrelated debuffs.
claim: Insufficient coverage raises the likelihood and stakes of a fitting Colony Encounter instead of applying a constant stack of unrelated debuffs.

quote: JOIN, GATHER, and CONNECT alter Load, resilience, failure geometry, and lived experience.
claim: JOIN, GATHER, and CONNECT alter Load, resilience, failure geometry, and lived experience.

quote: Local ecology and ordinary Practices support continued life. Exceptional materials, knowledge, access, and growth arrive through Expeditions.
claim: Local ecology and ordinary Practices support continued life at Home, while exceptional materials, knowledge, access, and growth arrive through Expeditions.

quote: The interface should settle at Dawn, explain what changed, and then grant permission to linger without real-time deterioration.
claim: The interface should settle at Dawn, explain what changed, and then grant permission to linger without real-time deterioration.

quote: Good Home play produces successful stillness.
claim: Good Home play produces successful stillness.

quote: Citizen | A named member of the colony who contributes one equal Home share, occupies a current Role, may travel Away, and carries individual history. | A variable-output worker token or permanent profession.
claim: A Citizen is a named colony member contributing one equal Home share, occupying a current Role, able to travel Away, and carrying individual history, not a variable-output worker token or permanent profession.

quote: Role, may travel Away, and carries individual history. | A variable-output worker token or permanent profession. | | Role | A share of current civic responsibility: Builder, Caretaker, Watchkeeper, and so forth. | A character class, aptitude score, or lifelong career.
claim: A Role is a share of current civic responsibility such as Builder, Caretaker, or Watchkeeper, not a character class, aptitude score, or lifelong career.

quote: Practice | The repeated communal activity sustained by a Role: upkeep, cultivation, warning, teaching, care, fabrication. | A hidden production recipe detached from daily life.
claim: A Practice is the repeated communal activity sustained by a Role, such as upkeep, cultivation, warning, teaching, care, or fabrication, not a hidden production recipe detached from daily life.

quote: Place | The built or claimed environment in which a Practice becomes materially possible and socially legible. | A stand-alone factory whose primary purpose is output per minute.
claim: A Place is the built or claimed environment in which a Practice becomes materially possible and socially legible, not a stand-alone factory whose primary purpose is output per minute.

quote: Project | A deliberate, time-bounded undertaking measured in Citizen-Days: construction, expansion, repair, preparation, or memorial work. | An endless passive queue that must remain full.
claim: A Project is a deliberate, time-bounded undertaking measured in Citizen-Days such as construction, expansion, repair, preparation, or memorial work, not an endless passive queue that must remain full.

quote: Condition | A global colony state such as Structural Condition, Stores, Cohesion, or seasonal preparedness. | A separate health bar on every wall, ladder, pantry, and burrow.
claim: A Condition is a global colony state such as Structural Condition, Stores, Cohesion, or seasonal preparedness, not a separate health bar on every wall, ladder, pantry, and burrow.

quote: Named Citizen** | **occupies** | **Role** | **sustains** | **Practice** | **inhabits** | **Place
claim: A Named Citizen occupies a Role, which sustains a Practice, which inhabits a Place.

quote: Role assignment is fluid and colony-scaled. Reassigning a Citizen changes the colony's posture; it is not a respec operation. A Citizen assigned as a Builder contributes one Builder Capacity regardless of personality, Away statistics, or prior assignment. The player sees exactly which Citizens make up the total, preserving individual apportionment without turning Home into a personnel-ranking puzzle.
claim: Role assignment is fluid and colony-scaled, changing colony posture rather than acting as a respec operation; a Citizen assigned as Builder contributes one Builder Capacity regardless of personality, Away statistics, or prior assignment, and the player sees exactly which Citizens make up the total.

quote: Home gives Citizens history. Away gives Citizens progression.
claim: Home gives Citizens history; Away gives Citizens progression.

quote: A Role normally sustains an ongoing Practice. Positive margin may be redirected into a Project. For example, Builder Capacity first covers the colony's routine Building Load; any remaining margin can accelerate a construction Project or prepare for forecast pressure. The system does not describe ordinary life as Citizens being "idle" when no queue is active.
claim: A Role normally sustains an ongoing Practice, and positive margin may be redirected into a Project, such as Builder Capacity first covering routine Building Load with remaining margin accelerating a construction Project or preparing for forecast pressure; the system does not describe idle Citizens when no queue is active.

quote: Species identity is embedded directly into land use. A well-designed settlement should remain identifiable when uninhabited. Placement alignment is represented primarily by how layout changes relevant Load, route resilience, warning, care, and failure propagation - not by a generic universal percentage pasted onto every system.
claim: Species identity is embedded in land use, remaining identifiable when uninhabited, represented by how layout changes relevant Load, route resilience, warning, care, and failure propagation rather than a generic universal percentage.

quote: Mouse | JOIN | Manor House | New Places belong to one protected inhabited system through shared walls, foundations, doorways, enclosed passages, or short covered links. | Continuity reduces enclosure and circulation Load, but a poorly joined failure can propagate through adjacent rooms.
claim: Mouse placement verb JOIN forms the Manor House image: new Places belong to one protected inhabited system via shared walls, foundations, doorways, or covered links, reducing enclosure and circulation Load but risking propagation of a poorly joined failure through adjacent rooms.

quote: Rabbit | GATHER | Court / Cul-de-Sac | Burrows and Places orient toward shared negative space: green, hearth, meeting court, or working yard. | Coherent courts reduce Care and Coordination Load; oversized or fragmented courts lose mutual visibility and neighbor-scale intimacy.
claim: Rabbit placement verb GATHER forms the Court/Cul-de-Sac image: burrows and Places orient toward shared negative space, with coherent courts reducing Care and Coordination Load while oversized or fragmented courts lose mutual visibility and neighbor-scale intimacy.

quote: Squirrel | CONNECT | Web | Separated nodes are linked by credible routes. Redundancy, not proximity alone, turns an outpost into colony space. | Alternate routes reduce Watch, provisioning, and isolation Load; one-route branches remain brittle.
claim: Squirrel placement verb CONNECT forms the Web image: separated nodes are linked by credible redundant routes, reducing Watch, provisioning, and isolation Load, while one-route branches remain brittle.

quote: Leadership | Central chamber, long table, or protected inner room. | Council green, elder burrow, or court-facing meeting place. | High junction or network node visible from several routes.
claim: Leadership is expressed as a central chamber for Mouse, a council green or elder burrow for Rabbit, and a high junction or network node visible from several routes for Squirrel.

quote: Care | Deep, sheltered sickroom connected to family rooms. | Quiet infirmary burrow near but not inside court bustle. | Recovery drey reachable by two safe routes.
claim: Care is expressed as a deep sheltered sickroom for Mouse, a quiet infirmary burrow for Rabbit, and a recovery drey reachable by two safe routes for Squirrel.

quote: Craft | Attached workshop within the protected body. | Workshop facing a shared working yard. | Work platform placed along supply and cache routes.
claim: Craft is expressed as an attached workshop for Mouse, a workshop facing a shared yard for Rabbit, and a work platform along supply and cache routes for Squirrel.

quote: Storage | Deep pantry rooms within the Manor. | Household stores plus a communal reserve near the court. | Distributed caches with deliberate redundancy.
claim: Storage is expressed as deep pantry rooms for Mouse, household stores plus communal reserve for Rabbit, and distributed caches with deliberate redundancy for Squirrel.

quote: Teaching | Warm interior gathering room and accumulated objects. | Circle on the common green or in a court-side chamber. | Teaching perch or route junction where several branches meet.
claim: Teaching is expressed as a warm interior gathering room for Mouse, a circle on the common green for Rabbit, and a teaching perch or route junction for Squirrel.

quote: Mouse builds rooms. Rabbit builds neighbors. Squirrel builds connections.
claim: Mouse builds rooms, Rabbit builds neighbors, Squirrel builds connections.

quote: The reference Role set below supplies the Home economy. Exact labels may vary by culture or species, but the structural distinction is canonical: every Role contributes globally, each assigned Citizen contributes one equal unit, and not every Role is relevant to every Encounter family.
claim: The reference Role set supplies the Home economy with labels that may vary by culture or species, but the structural distinction is canonical: every Role contributes globally, each assigned Citizen contributes one equal unit, and not every Role is relevant to every Encounter family.

quote: Builder | Workshop, yard, joined structural spaces | Absorbs routine Building Load and supports general upkeep. | Construction, reinforcement, major restoration, route or chamber expansion. | Collapse, flood damage, wind, frost heave, overextension.
claim: The Builder Role is supported by Workshop, yard, and joined structural spaces, absorbs routine Building Load and general upkeep, is used for construction, reinforcement, restoration, and expansion Projects, and is eligible for Encounters concerning collapse, flood damage, wind, frost heave, and overextension.

quote: Caretaker | Stores, kitchen, household commons | Protects stores, coordinates household logistics, dependents, and ordinary preservation. | Evacuation, stock movement, preserve batches, resettlement. | Spoilage, displacement, crowding, household disorder.
claim: The Caretaker Role is supported by Stores, kitchen, and household commons, protects stores and coordinates household logistics and dependents, is used for evacuation, stock movement, preserve batches, and resettlement, and is eligible for Encounters concerning spoilage, displacement, crowding, and household disorder.

quote: Watchkeeper | Watchpost, edge, high line, listening station | Provides warning, route oversight, and early detection. | Focused watch, forecast preparation, threat survey. | Predator arrival, flood warning, human work, route closure.
claim: The Watchkeeper Role is supported by Watchpost, edge, high line, and listening station, provides warning and route oversight, is used for focused watch, forecast preparation, and threat survey, and is eligible for Encounters concerning predator arrival, flood warning, human work, and route closure.

quote: Leader | Council Place, town center, meeting table | Coordinates decisions, buffers social strain, and enables colony-scale action. | Tier decisions, emergency mobilization, founding, dispute resolution. | Panic, disagreement, uneven sacrifice, community labor.
claim: The Leader Role is supported by Council Place, town center, and meeting table, coordinates decisions and buffers social strain, is used for Tier decisions, emergency mobilization, founding, and dispute resolution, and is eligible for Encounters concerning panic, disagreement, uneven sacrifice, and community labor.

quote: Gardener | Garden, food plot, managed resource node | Sustains green-season Perishable food and cultivation health. | Harvest, planting, soil recovery, seasonal transition. | Crop loss, drought, washout, poor yield, winter gap.
claim: The Gardener Role is supported by Garden, food plot, and managed resource node, sustains green-season Perishable food and cultivation health, is used for harvest, planting, soil recovery, and seasonal transition, and is eligible for Encounters concerning crop loss, drought, washout, poor yield, and winter gap.

quote: Crafter | Workshop, material store, tool bench | Maintains ordinary tools and converts recovered material into useful forms. | Gear, upgrades, structural components, expedition Supplies. | Tool failure, emergency bracing, material substitution.
claim: The Crafter Role is supported by Workshop, material store, and tool bench, maintains ordinary tools and converts recovered material into useful forms, is used for gear, upgrades, structural components, and expedition Supplies, and is eligible for Encounters concerning tool failure, emergency bracing, and material substitution.

quote: Healer | Hospital, herb room, recovery Place | Provides medical readiness, patient care, and recovery support. | Treatment, medicine preparation, triage, rehabilitation. | Injury, illness, cold exposure, post-Encounter recovery.
claim: The Healer Role is supported by Hospital, herb room, and recovery Place, provides medical readiness, patient care, and recovery support, is used for treatment, medicine preparation, triage, and rehabilitation, and is eligible for Encounters concerning injury, illness, cold exposure, and post-Encounter recovery.

quote: Teacher | Circle, archive, story room, shared green | Sustains knowledge transmission, social memory, and continuity. | Lessons, integrating discoveries, memorial and cultural Projects. | Newcomer integration, lost knowledge, grief, identity strain.
claim: The Teacher Role is supported by Circle, archive, story room, and shared green, sustains knowledge transmission and social memory, is used for lessons, integrating discoveries, and memorial and cultural Projects, and is eligible for Encounters concerning newcomer integration, lost knowledge, grief, and identity strain.

quote: Secondary Practice guardrail. The earliest 0.4.7 concept assigned every Role an automatic downtime output. This specification keeps the useful idea - no one becomes a dead slot - but reframes it as ordinary Practice rather than passive production.
claim: The earliest 0.4.7 concept assigned every Role an automatic downtime output; this specification keeps the goal that no one becomes a dead slot but reframes it as ordinary Practice rather than passive production.

quote: Crafters do not create advanced Supplies from nothing; they convert salvage.
claim: Crafters do not create advanced Supplies from nothing; they convert salvage.

quote: Teachers do not fill an abstract beauty meter; specific Lessons, memories, and cultural Projects produce visible artifacts.
claim: Teachers do not fill an abstract beauty meter; specific Lessons, memories, and cultural Projects produce visible artifacts.

quote: Preservation belongs wherever the colony's fiction places household food knowledge, usually Caretaking, Kitchen, or herbal Practice.
claim: Preservation belongs wherever the colony's fiction places household food knowledge, usually Caretaking, Kitchen, or herbal Practice.

quote: Projects are measured in integer Citizen-Days. A Project costing 2 Citizen-Days may be completed by one available Citizen in two game days or by two Citizens in one day.
claim: Projects are measured in integer Citizen-Days; a Project costing 2 Citizen-Days may be completed by one available Citizen in two game days or by two Citizens in one day.

quote: Assigned citizens are still named and visible, but the calculation does not require pathfinding each hammer strike, basket transfer, or wall patch.
claim: Assigned citizens are still named and visible, but the calculation does not require pathfinding each hammer strike, basket transfer, or wall patch.

quote: Reinforce the east roofline | 3 Citizen-Days | 1 Citizen for 3 days; 3 Citizens for 1 day; mixed allocation | A concentrated Project beyond routine upkeep.
claim: Reinforce the east roofline costs 3 Citizen-Days, staffable as 1 Citizen for 3 days, 3 Citizens for 1 day, or mixed allocation, representing a concentrated Project beyond routine upkeep.

quote: Prepare winter pantry | 4 Citizen-Days | 2 Caretakers for 2 days, or 1 for 4 days | Transforms existing stores and space; does not create food ex nihilo.
claim: Prepare winter pantry costs 4 Citizen-Days, staffable as 2 Caretakers for 2 days or 1 for 4 days, and transforms existing stores and space rather than creating food ex nihilo.

quote: Establish a far cache | 2 Citizen-Days | 1 Crafter/Builder share for 2 days or 2 shares for 1 day | Creates Squirrel network capability and adds future Watch/Provisioning Load.
claim: Establish a far cache costs 2 Citizen-Days, staffable as 1 Crafter/Builder share for 2 days or 2 shares for 1 day, and creates Squirrel network capability while adding future Watch/Provisioning Load.

quote: 1. Resolve citizen presence.** Apply expedition absence, injury, treatment, and temporary unavailability.
claim: Dawn adjudication first resolves citizen presence, applying expedition absence, injury, treatment, and temporary unavailability.

quote: 2. Apply Role assignments.** Count one Capacity per present Citizen assigned to each Role.
claim: Dawn adjudication counts one Capacity per present Citizen assigned to each Role.

quote: 3. Calculate current Loads.** Population, Places, season, spatial alignment, active Projects, Conditions, and forecast pressure determine demand.
claim: Dawn adjudication calculates current Loads from population, Places, season, spatial alignment, active Projects, Conditions, and forecast pressure.

quote: 4. Determine Margins.** Capacity minus Load is calculated per Role; any negative values enter the hidden Deficiency Ledger.
claim: Dawn adjudication calculates Margins as Capacity minus Load per Role, and any negative values enter the hidden Deficiency Ledger.

quote: 5. Resolve routine economy.** Daily sustenance is consumed; perishable spoilage, preservation, recovery, and Project progress are adjudicated.
claim: Dawn adjudication resolves routine economy: daily sustenance is consumed, and perishable spoilage, preservation, recovery, and Project progress are adjudicated.

quote: 6. Update Encounter pressure.** Deficient Role count, deficit depth, persistence, and cooldown rules update shortfall-Encounter cadence.
claim: Dawn adjudication updates Encounter pressure using deficient Role count, deficit depth, persistence, and cooldown rules to update shortfall-Encounter cadence.

quote: 7. Surface only meaningful changes.** The player receives a compact ledger, not a continuous stream of real-time maintenance alarms.
claim: Dawn adjudication surfaces only meaningful changes: the player receives a compact ledger, not a continuous stream of real-time maintenance alarms.

quote: Dawn is the accounting boundary. The rest of the day is allowed to feel inhabited.
claim: Dawn is the accounting boundary; the rest of the day is allowed to feel inhabited.

quote: A Citizen present for half a day sets a Half-Day Flag for the relevant Role. The first half-day receives full credit; the next missing half-day clears the flag and removes one full day of contribution.
claim: A Citizen present for half a day sets a Half-Day Flag for the relevant Role: the first half-day receives full credit, and the next missing half-day clears the flag and removes one full day of contribution.

quote: The implementation remains integer-based while avoiding artificial punishment for departures and returns that straddle the daily boundary.
claim: The half-day proration implementation remains integer-based while avoiding artificial punishment for departures and returns that straddle the daily boundary.

quote: The Hybrid Readiness Engine combines visible Role margins with an obscured vulnerability director. The player can understand why the colony is thin without predicting the exact incident card or optimization formula.
claim: The Hybrid Readiness Engine combines visible Role margins with an obscured vulnerability director, so the player can understand why the colony is thin without predicting the exact incident card or optimization formula.

quote: Role Margin = Role Capacity - Current Role Load
claim: Role Margin equals Role Capacity minus Current Role Load.

quote: \+2 or more - Reserve | The Practice has meaningful slack beyond current obligations. | Routine needs are covered; Projects, preparation, or emergency substitution are possible. | This Role can absorb absence or additional pressure.
claim: A Margin of +2 or more (Reserve) means the Practice has meaningful slack beyond current obligations, routine needs are covered with room for Projects, preparation, or emergency substitution, and this Role can absorb absence or additional pressure.

quote: \+1 - Ready | The Practice has one useful share of spare capacity. | Routine needs are covered with limited readiness. | A forecast event may be handled silently.
claim: A Margin of +1 (Ready) means the Practice has one useful share of spare capacity, routine needs are covered with limited readiness, and a forecast event may be handled silently.

quote: 0 - Covered | Capacity exactly meets normal Load. | The colony is stable but brittle in this category. | Nothing is wrong, but there is no spare response.
claim: A Margin of 0 (Covered) means Capacity exactly meets normal Load, the colony is stable but brittle in this category, and there is no spare response.

quote: \-1 - Thin | One share of responsibility is unsupported. | No automatic damage; a deficiency is recorded. | A relevant incident is more likely and choices may be expensive.
claim: A Margin of -1 (Thin) means one share of responsibility is unsupported, no automatic damage occurs but a deficiency is recorded, a relevant incident becomes more likely, and choices may be expensive.

quote: \-2 or worse - Exposed | A deep or prolonged shortfall exists. | Pressure rises faster and severe manifestations become eligible. | The colony is knowingly operating beyond its support.
claim: A Margin of -2 or worse (Exposed) means a deep or prolonged shortfall exists, pressure rises faster and severe manifestations become eligible, and the colony is knowingly operating beyond its support.

quote: N/A | No current contextual demand for the Role. | The Role does not enter the deficiency count. | An empty category is not automatically a failure.
claim: An N/A Margin means there is no current contextual demand for the Role, the Role does not enter the deficiency count, and an empty category is not automatically a failure.

quote: Load is contextual, not merely unlocked. A colony without patients need not be deficient in Healers; a colony with no children, lessons, integration burden, or knowledge transition may have no active Teaching Load. Conversely, a large, exposed settlement or a major winter transition may create genuine demand in several Roles at once.
claim: Load is contextual, not merely unlocked: a colony without patients need not be deficient in Healers, a colony with no children or knowledge transition may have no active Teaching Load, and conversely a large exposed settlement or major winter transition may create genuine demand in several Roles at once.

quote: Population and households | More residents, dependents, patients, stores, and social coordination. | Rabbit court scale may reduce or increase Care and Leadership Load.
claim: Population and households as a Load source cover more residents, dependents, patients, stores, and social coordination, and Rabbit court scale may reduce or increase Care and Leadership Load.

quote: Settlement extent | Rooms, courts, nodes, entrances, routes, and remote Places. | Mouse continuity, Rabbit court coherence, and Squirrel route redundancy change the cost of extent.
claim: Settlement extent as a Load source covers rooms, courts, nodes, entrances, routes, and remote Places, and Mouse continuity, Rabbit court coherence, and Squirrel route redundancy change the cost of extent.

quote: Season and forecast | Winter, heavy rain, wind, drought, heat, migration, human maintenance. | Species-specific shelter and movement patterns determine which Roles face pressure.
claim: Season and forecast as a Load source cover winter, heavy rain, wind, drought, heat, migration, and human maintenance, and species-specific shelter and movement patterns determine which Roles face pressure.

quote: Active Projects | Construction, founding, preservation, upgrades, treatment, cultural work. | Projects draw on positive margin or deliberately create temporary thinness.
claim: Active Projects as a Load source cover construction, founding, preservation, upgrades, treatment, and cultural work, and Projects draw on positive margin or deliberately create temporary thinness.

quote: Current Conditions | Structural strain, spoiled stores, displacement, illness, unresolved grief. | The same global condition manifests through species-specific Places and social forms.
claim: Current Conditions as a Load source cover structural strain, spoiled stores, displacement, illness, and unresolved grief, and the same global condition manifests through species-specific Places and social forms.

quote: Expedition absence | Named Citizens temporarily stop supplying Home Capacity. | A party choice becomes a legible colony posture change before departure.
claim: Expedition absence as a Load source means named Citizens temporarily stop supplying Home Capacity, and a party choice becomes a legible colony posture change before departure.

quote: Places and alignment provide fine tuning; headcount provides the heavy lifting.
claim: Places and alignment provide fine tuning while headcount provides the heavy lifting.

quote: Supporting Places may reduce specific Load, protect a Capacity from disruption, or make a response cheaper. They should not replace the need for Citizens entirely.
claim: Supporting Places may reduce specific Load, protect a Capacity from disruption, or make a response cheaper, but they should not replace the need for Citizens entirely.

claim: Deficient Role Count is the number of contextually demanded Roles with negative Margin, and it sets the breadth component of shortfall-Encounter pressure.

quote: Deficit Depth | Sum and per-Role depth of negative Margins. | Sets severity weighting and how quickly pressure accumulates.
claim: Deficit Depth is the sum and per-Role depth of negative Margins, and it sets severity weighting and how quickly pressure accumulates.

claim: Persistence is the number of consecutive Dawns a Role has remained thin or exposed, and it breaks ties, supports escalation, and distinguishes a deliberate brief risk from chronic neglect.

claim: Small Weakness is the second-worst relevant Role, and it defines collateral stakes, complication, or the second thing the player cannot easily protect.

claim: Relative vulnerability is the least buffered eligible Role even when all Margins are nonnegative, and it shapes unavoidable external events without increasing shortfall-generated frequency.

claim: Encounter generation applies the relevance mask so only Roles that genuinely matter to this family are considered.

claim: Encounter generation selects Big and Small Weakness as the two least-supported relevant Roles, shaping primary and collateral stakes.

quote: Projects | Daughter Court: 4 / 6 Citizen-Days | One Builder share and one Caretaker share committed today.
claim: Example Dawn ledger row: the Daughter Court Project is at 4/6 Citizen-Days, with one Builder share and one Caretaker share committed today.

quote: Home state | QUIET EQUILIBRIUM AT RISK | No crisis. Care coverage is thin; EMBODY remains available unless the strain becomes acute.
claim: Example Dawn ledger row: Home state is QUIET EQUILIBRIUM AT RISK — no crisis, Care coverage is thin, and EMBODY remains available unless the strain becomes acute.

quote: The exact threshold at which Strained blocks EMBODY should be a colony-wide rule, not a per-Citizen calculation.
claim: The exact threshold at which Strained blocks EMBODY should be a colony-wide rule, not a per-Citizen calculation.

quote: The key legibility promise is that the UI states why the mode is available or unavailable in plain language.
claim: The key legibility promise is that the UI states why the mode is available or unavailable in plain language.

quote: Entropy treadmill | Deficiency-driven Encounters arrive so often that the player can never regain attention. | Frequency saturation, minimum intervals, recovery windows, and severity growth instead of event spam.
claim: To prevent an entropy treadmill where deficiency-driven Encounters arrive too often to recover from, the design requires frequency saturation, minimum intervals, recovery windows, and severity growth rather than event spam.

quote: Even-spread optimization | The safest answer is one Citizen in every Role regardless of colony identity. | Contextual Loads, Role relevance masks, Place support, and legitimate specialization.
claim: To prevent even-spread optimization where one Citizen per Role is always safest, the design requires contextual Loads, Role relevance masks, Place support, and legitimate specialization.

quote: Chronic repetition | The same Builder shortage produces the same collapse every few days. | Category cooldowns, manifestation memory, species variants, escalation, and alternate secondary stakes.
claim: To prevent chronic repetition where the same shortage produces the same collapse repeatedly, the design requires category cooldowns, manifestation memory, species variants, escalation, and alternate secondary stakes.

quote: Opaque punishment | An Encounter feels unrelated to visible colony posture. | Visible Margin warnings, forecast context, Role advice, and post-event explanation.
claim: To prevent opaque punishment where an Encounter feels unrelated to visible colony posture, the design requires visible Margin warnings, forecast context, Role advice, and post-event explanation.

quote: Double charging | One deficiency is penalized through frequency, severity, passive decay, and repair cost simultaneously. | Treat MEET as the normal transaction; add extra layers only for deliberately major events.
claim: To prevent double charging a single deficiency across frequency, severity, decay, and repair cost simultaneously, MEET should be treated as the normal transaction, with extra layers added only for deliberately major events.

quote: Role irrelevance | Narrow Roles can be ignored because they enter too few Encounter families. | Ensure each Role has recurring routine Load and meaningful situation families without forcing false relevance.
claim: To prevent role irrelevance where narrow Roles can be ignored, each Role must have recurring routine Load and meaningful situation families without forcing false relevance.

quote: Unlocked-role tax | Unlocking a new Role automatically creates a deficiency. | N/A state until contextual demand actually exists.
claim: To prevent an unlocked-role tax where unlocking a new Role automatically creates a deficiency, such a Role must remain in an N/A state until contextual demand actually exists.

quote: Mandatory minigames | Manual domestic play is more profitable than abstraction. | EMBODY and presentation never provide exclusive economic yield.
claim: To prevent manual domestic play from being more profitable than abstraction, EMBODY and presentation must never provide exclusive economic yield.

quote: Roster ranking | Home aptitude creates obvious "best" Citizens and weak assignments. | One Citizen equals one Home Capacity; personal stats remain Away-facing.
claim: To prevent roster ranking where Home aptitude creates obvious best Citizens, one Citizen equals one Home Capacity while personal stats remain Away-facing.

quote: Small-colony collapse | One absence causes unrecoverable spirals at the earliest population scale. | Gentle Loads, substitution, short windows, and consequences scaled to colony tier.
claim: To prevent small-colony collapse where one absence causes unrecoverable spirals at early population scale, the design requires gentle Loads, substitution, short windows, and consequences scaled to colony tier.

quote: If two Roles share the same deficiency, persistence may break the tie; if still tied, recent manifestation history should favor variety.
claim: When two Roles share the same deficiency, persistence may break the tie, and if still tied, recent manifestation history should favor variety.

quote: If only one relevant weakness exists, the Small Weakness may be the least buffered eligible Role, a current Condition, or an environmental complication rather than an invented unrelated deficiency.
claim: If only one relevant weakness exists, the Small Weakness may be the least buffered eligible Role, a current Condition, or an environmental complication rather than an invented unrelated deficiency.

quote: Before departure, the player receives a clear delta: "Removing Moss reduces Watch Margin from +1 to 0" or "Taking Sedge creates Building Margin -1 until return."
claim: Before departure, the player receives a clear delta showing how removing or bringing an item changes a specific Margin, for example reducing Watch Margin from +1 to 0 or creating Building Margin -1 until return.

quote: Nothing must happen while they are away. The player accepted a risk, not a guaranteed tax.
claim: Nothing must happen automatically while the party is away; the player accepted a risk, not a guaranteed tax.

quote: If a fitting pressure arrives, the Register makes that thinness concrete.
claim: If a fitting pressure arrives while the party is away, the Register makes that thinness concrete.

quote: 1.** Home Mode resolves the Colony; Away Mode resolves individual Citizens.
claim: Home Mode resolves the Colony; Away Mode resolves individual Citizens.

quote: 2.** Every present Citizen assigned to a Role contributes one equal unit of Home Capacity.
claim: Every present Citizen assigned to a Role contributes one equal unit of Home Capacity.

quote: 3.** Roles are current civic responsibilities, not character classes or aptitude tracks.
claim: Roles are current civic responsibilities, not character classes or aptitude tracks.

quote: 4.** Places support Practices and alter contextual Load; they are not primarily stand-alone production factories.
claim: Places support Practices and alter contextual Load; they are not primarily stand-alone production factories.

quote: 5.** JOIN, GATHER, and CONNECT determine species spatial alignment, Load, resilience, and failure geometry.
claim: JOIN, GATHER, and CONNECT determine species spatial alignment, Load, resilience, and failure geometry.

quote: 6.** Adequate Capacity can fully cover routine Load. The colony can run well without continuous deterioration.
claim: Adequate Capacity can fully cover routine Load, so the colony can run well without continuous deterioration.

quote: 7.** Projects use integer Citizen-Days and represent chosen ambition, restoration, preparation, or civic meaning.
claim: Projects use integer Citizen-Days and represent chosen ambition, restoration, preparation, or civic meaning.

quote: 8.** Negative Role Margins enter an obscured Deficiency Ledger; not every empty Role is contextually deficient.
claim: Negative Role Margins enter an obscured Deficiency Ledger, though not every empty Role is contextually deficient.

quote: 9.** Deficient Role count and deficit depth set the frequency pressure for shortage-driven Colony Encounters.
claim: Deficient Role count and deficit depth set the frequency pressure for shortage-driven Colony Encounters.

quote: 10.** The Big and Small relevant Weaknesses determine the primary and collateral manifestation of a Home Encounter.
claim: The Big and Small relevant Weaknesses determine the primary and collateral manifestation of a Home Encounter.

quote: 11.** Home MEET normally offers two distinct spends and one refusal with a compounded consequence.
claim: Home MEET normally offers two distinct spends and one refusal with a compounded consequence.

quote: 12.** Global Conditions absorb diffuse consequences; specific Place Projects are reserved for transformative local outcomes.
claim: Global Conditions absorb diffuse consequences, while specific Place Projects are reserved for transformative local outcomes.

quote: 13.** Quiet Equilibrium makes EMBODY globally available at Home for any present and available Citizen.
claim: Quiet Equilibrium makes EMBODY globally available at Home for any present and available Citizen.

quote: 14.** Campaign Memory preserves meaningful domestic and Away history without becoming a mandatory buff economy.
claim: Campaign Memory preserves meaningful domestic and Away history without becoming a mandatory buff economy.

quote: An Age of Empires-style production optimization layer with service radii and worker throughput percentages.
claim: The design explicitly excludes an Age of Empires-style production optimization layer with service radii and worker throughput percentages.

quote: A full-time fight against arbitrary decay, hunger, or condition leakage.
claim: The design explicitly excludes a full-time fight against arbitrary decay, hunger, or condition leakage.

quote: Individual Home aptitude ratings, hidden career multipliers, or "best worker" roster sorting.
claim: The design explicitly excludes individual Home aptitude ratings, hidden career multipliers, or best-worker roster sorting.

quote: A separate local repair order for every damaged wall, ladder, room, burrow, or route.
claim: The design explicitly excludes a separate local repair order for every damaged wall, ladder, room, burrow, or route.

quote: An event screen with many near-duplicate choices or one obviously correct answer.
claim: The design explicitly excludes an event screen with many near-duplicate choices or one obviously correct answer.

quote: A simulation in which every Role must be staffed at all times regardless of context.
claim: The design explicitly excludes a simulation in which every Role must be staffed at all times regardless of context.

quote: A Home economy that creates unlimited advanced progression without Away materials and discoveries.
claim: The design explicitly excludes a Home economy that creates unlimited advanced progression without Away materials and discoveries.

quote: An emotional-content meter that turns friendship, memory, or EMBODY into another optimized currency.
claim: The design explicitly excludes an emotional-content meter that turns friendship, memory, or EMBODY into another optimized currency.

quote: Stable plateau | A sensibly arranged colony with covered routine Loads can pass multiple ordinary Dawns without degradation or compulsory action.
claim: The stable plateau acceptance test passes when a sensibly arranged colony with covered routine Loads can pass multiple ordinary Dawns without degradation or compulsory action.

quote: Legible absence | Before an Expedition, the player can understand exactly which Role share leaves and how margins change.
claim: The legible absence acceptance test passes when, before an Expedition, the player can understand exactly which Role share leaves and how margins change.

quote: Equal Home value | Swapping two healthy present Citizens in the same Role does not alter Capacity.
claim: The equal Home value acceptance test passes when swapping two healthy present Citizens in the same Role does not alter Capacity.

quote: Species distinction | The same population and functions produce visibly and mechanically different Mouse, Rabbit, and Squirrel settlements.
claim: The species distinction acceptance test passes when the same population and functions produce visibly and mechanically different Mouse, Rabbit, and Squirrel settlements.

quote: Silent success | Forecast pressure can be absorbed by readiness without opening MEET, and the player receives a brief diegetic confirmation.
claim: The silent success acceptance test passes when forecast pressure can be absorbed by readiness without opening MEET, giving the player a brief diegetic confirmation.

quote: Weakness manifestation | The same Heavy Winds family presents different stakes under Builder/Caretaker versus Watchkeeper/Leader weakness profiles.
claim: The weakness manifestation acceptance test passes when the same Heavy Winds family presents different stakes under Builder/Caretaker versus Watchkeeper/Leader weakness profiles.

quote: Three-choice clarity | A Home Encounter presents two materially different spends and a meaningful refusal, with understandable consequence previews.
claim: The three-choice clarity acceptance test passes when a Home Encounter presents two materially different spends and a meaningful refusal, with understandable consequence previews.

quote: No double charge | Resolving an Encounter normally completes the shortfall transaction without automatically spawning a second mandatory repair minigame.
claim: The no double charge acceptance test passes when resolving an Encounter normally completes the shortfall transaction without automatically spawning a second mandatory repair minigame.

quote: Recovery possibility | A strained colony has clear, achievable routes back to Quiet Equilibrium and is not trapped in escalating event spam.
claim: The recovery possibility acceptance test passes when a strained colony has clear, achievable routes back to Quiet Equilibrium and is not trapped in escalating event spam.

quote: EMBODY reward | When Quiet Equilibrium is restored, EMBODY becomes globally available at Home without checking individual Role margins.
claim: The EMBODY reward acceptance test passes when, upon restoration of Quiet Equilibrium, EMBODY becomes globally available at Home without checking individual Role margins.

quote: Campaign continuity | Named Citizens, Places, Projects, and Encounters can be referenced later as shared history even though Home output remains global.
claim: The campaign continuity acceptance test passes when named Citizens, Places, Projects, and Encounters can be referenced later as shared history even though Home output remains global.

quote: Advancement boundary | Home sustains and transforms; significant new capabilities still depend on Away discovery, salvage, knowledge, or relationships.
claim: The advancement boundary acceptance test passes when Home sustains and transforms while significant new capabilities still depend on Away discovery, salvage, knowledge, or relationships.

quote: The Home Loop succeeds when the colony is mechanically credible, strategically legible, capable of genuine equilibrium, and emotionally spacious enough that the player can care about the small lives the system protects.
claim: The Home Loop succeeds when the colony is mechanically credible, strategically legible, capable of genuine equilibrium, and emotionally spacious enough that the player can care about the small lives the system protects.

quote: The player is not asked to maximize a factory. The player is asked to establish a home that is materially sound, seasonally prepared, socially coherent, and capable of continuing ordinary life while selected Citizens travel into danger. The desired success state is not perpetual acceleration. It is a functioning colony with enough margin to remain stable, pursue chosen ambitions, and permit the player to notice the Citizens who inhabit it.
claim: The player's task is not to maximize a factory but to establish a home that is materially sound, seasonally prepared, socially coherent, and able to continue ordinary life while selected Citizens travel into danger; success is a functioning colony with enough margin to remain stable, pursue chosen ambitions, and let the player notice the Citizens who inhabit it.
